name: Promarchy
author: atlastimed
description: Proton Mail in the Omarchy bar: new-mail count, recent-mail dropdown and desktop notifications.

barWidget.description: Unread mail from the last hour, day or week as a badge, with a dropdown of recent messages.

schema.label: Badge counts unread mail from
schema.description: The number next to the icon: unread inbox mail received in the last hour, day or week, all unread mail, or no number.

schema.label: Check for mail every (seconds)
schema.description: Each check is one tiny request to Proton's event stream; mail is only re-read when something changed.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Show a notification when new mail arrives. Clicking it opens the message.

schema.label: Inbox categories
schema.description: "all", or a comma list of: primary, social, promotions, updates, forums, newsletters, transactions. Applies to the badge, dropdown and notifications.

schema.label: Group conversations
schema.description: Show a busy thread once, with a message count, instead of one row per reply.

schema.label: Sender logos
schema.description: Fetch sender logos through Proton's logo proxy, as the Proton web app does.

schema.label: Open mail in
schema.description: Your default browser, or a standalone web-app window.
